visualCharacteristics.purpose: Newsletter subscribe panel (visual only, no submission backend)
visualCharacteristics.description: Dark #020e40 panel, 30px padding: white 20px/600 heading, 54px email input (4px radius, #b3b3b3 border), three CSS-drawn white radio options, full-width blue pill button (25px radius, 18px).

contentPattern.description: Heading, email placeholder, 3 subscription options, button label
contentPattern.structure: row 1: heading; row 2: email placeholder; row 3: bulleted list of option labels (first is default); row 4: button label

usage.description: Article sidebar newsletter call to action.

reuseGuidance: Visual-only sign-up: submitting validates the email, prevents the request and shows an inline status message. Not the Forms add-on `form` block; replace or wire up when a subscription backend exists. Empty fields fall back to the Figma copy.
